note.note:
I don’t have the transcript or the DDx JSON included in your message. Please provide both so I can generate the SOAP clinical note.

What I need:
- The full transcript (doctor–patient conversation) exactly as text.
- The DDx JSON (the differential diagnosis output) exactly as provided.

Optional but helpful:
- Any vitals, exam findings, labs, imaging, medication names/doses, allergies, and past medical/surgical history if not fully captured in the transcript.

I will treat the transcript as the primary source and use the DDx only when consistent (flagging any conflicts). Once you send both, I will produce the SOAP note in the exact structure you specified.
